Practical consequence: any placement plan must be re-priced against the latest capture, not against a single measured rate; the frontier tracker's deltas are the only honest measure of what changed.

hypotheses.test: Deterministic arithmetic in scripts/leaderboard_lab.py -> data/leaderboard_lab.json: required daily compound = (balance multiple)^(1/remaining days) - 1; underlying equivalent = rate / 20; ruin arithmetic = 100% / 20x leverage; cross-checked by scripts/verify.py against the capture and config files.
evidence: Required daily compounding from the 2026-09-17T20:58:00Z capture (12.6264 days left): rank 1 +20.3236%/day, rank 50 +15.2122%/day, rank 100 +13.7017%/day, rank 250 +10.7815%/day. Underlying equivalents at 20:1: 1.0162% / 0.7606% / 0.6851% / 0.5391% per day.

Balance-multiple targets over the same window: 5x needs +13.5946%/day (0.6797% underlying), 10x +20.0050%/day (1.0002%), 20x +26.7770%/day (1.3389%), 50x +36.3192%/day (1.8160%), 100x +44.0119%/day (2.2006%); at an illustrative +1% underlying day with full reinvestment, 5x takes 9 unbroken winning days and 100x takes 26.

Exposure arithmetic: maximum initial notional is $5,000,000 (250,000 x 20), so 1% of underlying is $50,000 = 20% of the starting balance; a 2.5% adverse move erases half the balance and a 5% adverse move erases all of it. The rules forbid resetting the account (section 08), so the required path admits no full-exposure loss day.

Reality check from this repository's own tests: the three pre-registered models are refuted with $0.0 pooled median net profit across 231 windows (H14-H16), so no tested strategy has produced any positive daily compounding, let alone the unbroken sequence above. The arithmetic shows what the prize costs; it is not evidence that it can be earned.
